g.text: INGREDION THAILAND — SPRINT 18K TPA SPRAY DRYER PLANT (KALASIN)
ROCKWELL CONTROLLOGIX 5580 (1756-L950TPSXT) — 5-CHASSIS DLR NETWORK CABLE & 13-SLOT REDESIGN
PART 1: INDUSTRIAL ETHERNET DLR NETWORK ARCHITECTURE & CABLE ROUTING
MAIN CONTROL PANEL (MCP-01) — SAME ENCLOSURE (CS1 - CS4)
PART 2: REDESIGNED 13-SLOT CHASSIS SLOT DEFINITIONS & HARDWARE ELEVATION
STANDARDIZED BALANCED I/O ARCHITECTURE (4 DI / 2 DO / 2 AI / 2 AO / 2 SPARE PER RACK)
Network: Active DLR Supervisor + Supervisory Master
Location: Remote I/O Panel RIO200 (Area 200) via Fiber
1. REDESIGNED BILL OF MATERIALS & I/O QUANTITY MATRIX
2. DLR NETWORK CABLE SCHEDULE & RUN LIST
1. CS1 Slot 1 is the ACTIVE RING SUPERVISOR. Port 2 is beacon-blocked during normal operation.
2. DLR Beacon Interval configured at 400µs; single cable fault failover recovers in < 3ms.
3. Expansion chassis CS2–CS5 standardized with 1756-EN4TR in Slot 00 per Rockwell CPwE guideline.
